description: arXiv:2610.05533v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Harness search keeps a change to the prompts, token budgets or parsers around a frozen model if the change raises a score. Such a gain can come from answers the parser could not read before, a weak comparison or an evaluation defect. We preregistered two studies of where these gains come from, with three models of 1.7B to 8B parameters a...
